definitions.explanation: The action of opening and closing something, or the mechanism that enables this action.

examples.japanese: ドアの{開閉|かいへい}は{静|しず}かにお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please open and close the door quietly.

examples.japanese: {自動|じどう}{開閉|かいへい}ドアが{故障|こしょう}した。
{窓|まど}の{開閉|かいへい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: Open and close the window repeatedly.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{開|かい} (open) + {閉|へい} (close)
・A compound combining opposite actions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{開閉|かいへい}ボタン (open/close button)
・{開閉|かいへい}{式|しき} (opening type, opening mechanism)
・{自動|じどう}{開閉|かいへい} (automatic opening/closing)
・{手動|しゅどう}{開閉|かいへい} (manual opening/closing)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・Doors and gates
・Windows
・Lids and covers
・Electrical circuits ({回路|かいろ}の{開閉|かいへい})

SIMILAR COMPOUND WORDS:
・{出入|でい}り (going in and out)
・{売買|ばいばい} (buying and selling)
・{発着|はっちゃく} (arrival and departure)
